From Northern Japan.name: From Northern Japan
From Northern Japan.description:
❄️ You grew up in Tohoku or Hokkaido: long winters, deep snow, fishing ports and mountain towns.

🥶 You can work through the cold.
🆘 You know how to dig people out when the snow comes down.

📈 Grants: Conditioning +5, Search and Rescue +5
From Northern Japan.traitNarrativeEffects: Grew up in northern Japan, a Tohoku prefecture or Hokkaido as the player chooses (default: a snowy Tohoku town). How Musutafu and Tokyo treat them: the accent marks them as rural; some tease it, many assume patience, quiet and honesty, some mistake quiet for slow (exploitable). Other northerners treat them as kin. Cold barely registers; humid summers wear them down. Speech: slower and softer than Tokyo's, thicker on calls home; show a few words and rhythm, never phonetic spelling. Tohoku: 'nda' (yes), '-be' suggestions ('iku-be', let's go), 'shi' and 'su' blurred; Hokkaido: 'namara' (very), 'shibareru' (freezing), 'nageru' (throw out). Local knowledge: snow driving, clearing roofs, digging out neighbors, avalanche and tsunami drills, sea and mountain weather, fishing-port and farm work, how far the nearest hero agency is. Who they know: neighbors who dug each other out each winter, a volunteer firefighter or fisherman mentor, family sending rice, apples or seafood.
